page.overview:
Who is Organisms of Cobra-La?

The organisms of Cobra-La were biological creations used by the armed forces, and civilians, of the Cobra-La people. They fit into three categories: close quarter combat tools, transportation, and defensive/offensive weaponry.

The first type Ones were used by Pythona to infiltrate the Terror Drome and incapacitate numerous Cobra personnel when she infiltrated the Terror Drome. Nemesis Enforcer also used them on two occasions against Sgt. Slaughter. One of which was a octopus like mini-submersible that may or may not have also been used to rendezvous with the Dreadnoks after Zarana recorded the security of a G.I. Joe stockade. The second, which looked like a basketball chopped in half, was used by Pythona on a Crimson Guardsman, while Nemesis Enforcer used it during the rescue of Lt. Falcon. The third was a starfish shaped throwing-star that Nemesis Enforcer also used on another rifle Sgt. Slaughter held.

The next, and most dangerous of all, were a Type Three: hundreds of organic missile launch systems that were planted around the perimeter of the Cobra-la dome, which Roadblock dismissed as "redwood toadstools". They were dubbed Funguzoids by Golobulus, and as presumably passed on to Flint by Cobra Commander, the "warhead" of every one of them "contained a degenerative spore".

The next Type Two: A combination of tree and clam that Cobra Commander was imprisoned within during his trial. It was later inadvertently killed by Pythona while she fought Jinx in the final battle.
